policy_title: Deliver Tree Planting and Peatland Commitments
stated: The Conservative Party will deliver its tree planting and peatland commitments through Nature for Climate funding, unlock private investment, and cut red tape in the planning system for tree planting.

source.quote: Deliver our tree planting and peatland commitments through our Nature for Climate funding, and continuing our work to unlock private investment. ...Cut red tape that holds back the planting of trees in the planning system.

bearing_set.reason: Tree planting and peatland restoration directly affect emissions trajectories, carbon sequestration, biodiversity, water quality and climate resilience — core O6 indicators.

membership_note: The policy is a single-target environmental intervention; the 'cutting red tape' element is sector-specific and too narrow to move O10 in any non-negligible way, and the public-finance effect of Nature for Climate funding is not large enough to materially shift the debt-sustainability path required for an O12 bearing.
